children: Albertsons Companies reported second quarter fiscal 2026 results for the 12 weeks ended September 12, 2026, with net sales and other revenue of $18.895 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $784.0 million. The company posted net income of $51.5 million (diluted EPS $0.11) and adjusted net income per diluted share of $0.36. Identical sales declined 0.8% while digital sales rose 11% as the company initiates a comprehensive turnaround review.
Revenue (Net sales and other revenue): $18,894.7 million for the 12 weeks ended September 12, 2026.
Gross profit: $5,057.1 million; gross margin 26.8% for the quarter.
Operating income: $174.5 million for the quarter.
Net income: $51.5 million; basic and diluted net income per Class A common share $0.11 for the quarter.
Adjusted metrics: Adjusted net income $179.0 million (adjusted diluted EPS $0.36) and Adjusted EBITDA $784.0 million (4.1% of net sales and other revenue) for the quarter.
Identical sales decreased 0.8% year-over-year; digital sales increased 11% during the quarter, and pharmacy sales continued to grow despite IRA-related headwinds.
Company implemented "ACI Edge" operating realignment on July 23, 2026, consolidating 11 divisions into four regions and centralizing center-store merchandising under an enterprise team.

Launched a comprehensive business review covering customer strategy, cost structure, operating model, portfolio of banners and markets, and capital allocation priorities; the company suspended its fiscal 2026 outlook pending completion of the review.

Capital activity and operational investments during the first 28 weeks of fiscal 2026 included completion of 38 store remodels, opening seven new stores, and continued investment in digital and technology platforms.

Share repurchases and dividends: repurchased 26.0 million shares for $387.6 million in the first 28 weeks of fiscal 2026 and paid a quarterly dividend of $0.17 per share in August 2026 (next dividend announced for November 6, 2026).
